description: This file defines constants, data structures, callback types, and macros for the Beerocks BML (Beerocks Management Layer) API, used for network management, node information, statistics, and events within the prplMesh project.

classes.name: BML_VAP_INFO
classes.description: Structure containing information about a Virtual Access Point (VAP), including type, authentication, encryption, MAC addresses, SSID, and key.

classes.name: BML_NODE
classes.description: Represents a network node with properties such as type, state, MAC, IP, name, radio info, and connection details.

classes.name: BML_STATS
classes.description: Structure for network statistics, including type, MAC, data transfer metrics, and node-specific parameters.

classes.name: BML_EVENT
classes.description: Generic event structure containing context, type, and event data pointer.

classes.name: BML_DEVICE_DATA
classes.description: Contains device (agent) information including radio status and MAC address.

classes.name: BML_NODE_ITER
classes.description: Iterator for exploring network map nodes with functions to traverse and access nodes.

classes.name: BML_STATS_ITER
classes.description: Iterator for exploring statistics list with functions to traverse and access statistics nodes.

classes.name: BML_NEIGHBOR_AP
classes.description: Represents information about a neighboring access point, including SSID, BSSID, mode, channel, signal strength, security, and supported standards.

classes.name: BML_CLIENT_CONFIG
classes.description: Configuration parameters for a client, including radio preferences and lifetime.

classes.name: BML_CLIENT
classes.description: Represents a client with MAC, configuration, and connection details.

classes.name: BML_UNASSOC_STA_LINK_METRIC
classes.description: Metrics for unassociated station link quality, including MAC, opclass, channel, RCPI, and measurement delta.

methods.name: BML_NW_MAP_QUERY_CB
methods.description: Callback for network map query/update responses.
